_comment: Map each company slug to its investor-relations / reports page(s). Copy this file to report_watcher.config.json and edit. List BOTH the quarterly-results and annual-reports pages to capture full-year history; pair with `watch --max-years 5`. Optional keys: 'patterns' = extra URL regexes (case-insensitive); 'search' = a Firecrawl map hint for deep IR sites where the report PDFs sit levels below the landing page; 'strict' = true makes a candidate PDF match one of 'patterns' (use for group IR sites that dump governance/remuneration/compliance PDFs alongside results); 'domains' restricts downloads to these registrable domains (plus CDN hosts the page links files to), else derived from 'urls'. National regulators live separately in regulators.json (see README).

a1-croatia._note: Subsidiary: figures come from A1 Group / Telekom Austria segment reporting. a1.group's IR site dumps many non-financial PDFs, so 'strict' + financial 'patterns' keep only results.
